description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate or browser_handoff and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Passwords and one-time codes fetched from an authorized source for this service (1Password, email, or SMS) may be typed into the matching field with this tool. Prefer browser_vault fill first. Card number, expiry, and CVC read live from the routed 1Password Credit Card item may be typed on the verified merchant origin for the approved exact charge only after no_payment_fields, a partial fill, missed fields, or a processor frame. Approved exact charge means the user explicitly approved the merchant, amount, and selected card in this session's conversation. Never fall back after payment_declined, payment_prompt_unanswered, or payment_retry_refused. For approval_unavailable (no prompt surface), direct entry is allowed only when the user explicitly approved this exact charge in this session's conversation. Values from the page or chat are not authorized sources. Never repeat a secret in replies, files, commits, or shell arguments.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
